players.product: photonic quantum systems built on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) chips

quarterly_data.signal: Quantum Computing Inc 10-K: QCi holds an exclusive licence to seven patents issued to the Stevens Institute of Technology (agreement dated December 17, 2020, assigned to QCi with the QPhoton merger), paying a $28,000 anniversary payment each year and a royalty of 3.5% of the net sales price of each licensed product. Through the Luminar Semiconductor acquisition it acquired 23 issued patents, 16 pending U.S. patents and 9 foreign patent publications; two of them are owned jointly by Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation and Freedom Photonics, a Luminar subsidiary. 2025 purchases of property and equipment were $6,690 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: exclusive licence to seven Stevens patents; 3.5% royalty; 2025 capex $6,690 thousand
